text: dsh-think-translate 是面向 DSH Web 的显示层翻译插件，可将思考链、任务卡片、回答正文和自动审查拒绝理由翻译为九种语言。客户端提供设置面板、独立翻译页和可选侧边栏入口；Host 端通过同源接口连接 Google、Bing、Ollama、OpenAI 兼容接口或 Anthropic，并按顺序尝试已启用的提供方。它还支持按语言维护术语表、保护代码与路径、缓存译文以及管理本地模型。适合希望用熟悉语言阅读 DSH 对话的 Web 用户；可用免费在线翻译或本机 Ollama，也可配置自己的模型服务。

dsh-think-translate translates DSH Web reasoning, tasks, and answers into nine languages. Its settings page and optional sidebar connect Google, Bing, Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, or Anthropic providers. It also offers glossaries, protects code, and manages local models.

I need a glossary so technical terms stay consistent across translations.
dsh-think-translate 的功能「思考链翻译」：将思考区段按段落和句子分批翻译，并提供预翻译、懒加载历史或展开后翻译等模式。用户可在设置中选择目标语言和翻译模式。
dsh-think-translate 的功能「任务与回答翻译」：把任务卡片、输入区任务列表以及回答正文显示为目标语言，相关内容可通过独立开关控制。译文用于界面展示。
dsh-think-translate 的功能「多提供方翻译链」：按用户排列的顺序尝试已启用的 Google、Bing、OpenAI 兼容、Anthropic 或 Ollama 提供方；失败或明显语言不符时可继续尝试后续提供方。
dsh-think-translate 的功能「术语表」：用户可按目标语言编辑术语对，并选择启用自定义词条或内置技术词表。翻译时术语表用于保持专名和技术词汇的译法一致。
dsh-think-translate 的功能「翻译控制入口」：在设置中选择目标语言、翻译项目和提供方，并可把控制页固定到全局侧边栏；页面与设置面板复用同一组翻译控制。
dsh-think-translate 的功能「本地模型管理」：设置界面可准备 Ollama 和模型、查看准备状态，并按需加载或释放本地模型；空闲释放时间可调整。
dsh-think-translate 的功能「技术文本保留」：提交翻译前识别并保护代码、路径、命令等片段，只翻译普通文字，再把原有技术内容放回结果。
dsh-think-translate 使用 Google、Bing 或用户配置的模型提供方时，会将待翻译文字提交给所选服务；选择 Ollama 可改用本机模型。
dsh-think-translate 只有在用户点击本地准备操作时才会下载缺少的 Ollama 软件或模型；本机模型服务默认指向 localhost:11434。

dsh-think-translate README · Connect providers you already use：**Ollama · Google · Bing · OpenAI · Anthropic Messages API** Discover providers already configured in DSH without entering endpoints and keys again. Test each provider separately; list order controls the order of attempts. ```text Your first choice → next enabled provider → … → originals if all fail ```
Custom endpoints, credentials and recovery

dsh-think-translate README · Connect providers you already use：- Custom endpoints support OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` and the native Anthropic Messages API.
- Discovery reads the current DSH profile and overrides. Rescan and add discovered providers to the translation chain.
- An `apiKeyEnv` key is resolved at request time; resolved credentials are never written back to plugin configuration.
- Manually entered keys are saved through DSH credentials; plugin configuration stores references only. Legacy literal keys migrate when that service is available. Unavailable storage rejects new literal-key saves; a failed migration retains the previous configuration.
- Configuration responses never contain saved key values. Leave an edited key field blank to retain it; explicitly select “Remove saved key” to delete it. DSH owns credential-file access protection; this is not OS-keychain encryption.
- Successful translations persist in the current browser, separated by provider, model and translation configuration. Configuration changes invalidate old results, including requests already in flight. Cache-version upgrades retain preferences.
- Failures cool down in host memory for 30

dsh-think-translate README · Glossary: consistent terms：The built-in glossary and custom entries have separate checkboxes in their own sections. Both apply immediately and independently; disabling either keeps your entries. The opt-in preset contains 60 common English AI/programming terms and product names for all nine target languages. Enabled custom terms override matching built-ins and retain 128 extra slots. Unsaved edits highlight Save and show reminders, including drafts in other languages. Wide pages use side-by-side preset/custom panes and horizontal status; narrow pages and dialogs stack them.

dsh-think-translate README · Glossary: consistent terms：Each target language has its own glossary in settings and the sidebar translation page. Enter one source => translation pair per line and save. Using the same text on both sides preserves a product name.

```text
DeepSeek => DeepSeek
智能体 => AI agent
思考过程 => reasoning
```

dsh-think-translate README · Glossary: consistent terms：English matches whole words without case sensitivity; longer terms take precedence. Code, paths and commands remain intact. Up to 128 entries per language. Saving invalidates old translations; disabling the glossary keeps your entries. Terms apply to prose actually submitted for translation, without rewriting the original.

dsh-think-translate README · Local translation models: load and release on demand：| Your action | Plugin behavior |
|---|---|
| Translate or test | Start the service and load the selected model on demand |
| Release model memory | Wait for active translations, then unload; preserve files, switches and order |
| Uncheck the local provider | Disable it and unload the selected model |
| Re-enable it or open settings | No preload; load on the next actual translation |
| Set idle release | 5 minutes by default; choose 1 / 5 / 10 / 30 / 60 minutes or off |

Development and internals

dsh-think-translate README · Answers to common questions：- `lib/index.js`: host routes, providers, configuration, memory cache and local model lifecycle.
- `lib/client.js`: settings, display-layer translation, streaming batches and browser cache.
- `lib/config.json`: runtime configuration, excluded from Git and npm.
- No extra build step: source files are the deliverable. Restart DSH after changing host code.
- Run checks with `npm test`. Discovery and credential handling are documented in the [maintenance notes](https://github.com/UncleK/dsh-think-translate/blob/main/docs/maintenance-notes.md).
- Push/PR CI runs `npm ci --ignore-scripts` and `npm test` on Windows/Linux with Node 20/22/24/26. Node 20 checks the declared compatibility floor; required merge checks need separate repository settings.
- Protection covers Markdown code, recognizable paths, URLs, filenames and common command fragments. Quote paths containing spaces; use backticks or fenced blocks for complex commands and ambiguous technical text.

text:
dsh-think-translate README · 连接你已经在用的提供方：- 自定义端点支持 OpenAI 兼容的 `/v1/chat/completions` 和原生 Anthropic Messages API。
- 自动发现当前 DSH profile 及覆盖配置中的提供方；可重新扫描并加入翻译链。
- 声明 `apiKeyEnv` 的提供方在请求时解析密钥，解析结果不会写回插件配置。
- 手动输入的密钥通过 DSH 凭据服务保存，插件配置只保存引用；服务可用时自动迁移旧配置中的明文密钥。凭据服务不可用时拒绝保存新的明文密钥，迁移失败保留旧配置。
- 配置接口不返回密钥值。编辑时留空保留旧密钥，勾选“移除已保存的密钥”才会删除；DSH 凭据文件由宿主保护，不代表系统钥匙串加密。
- 成功译文缓存在当前浏览器，按提供方、模型和翻译配置区分；变更配置后不复用旧译文，已开始的旧请求也不会回写到新缓存。缓存版本升级会清理旧译文，但保留语言等首选项。
- 失败结果在 Host 内存冷却 30 秒，之后翻译会恢复重试。
- 已经是目标语言的正文会按语言检测规则跳过；提供方测试仍会真实发起请求。

</details>

dsh-think-translate README · 术语表：让译法保持一致：“启用内置词表”和“启用自定义词条”分别放在对应区域，独立勾选、立即保存。内置词表默认关闭，含 60 条常用英文 AI、编程术语和产品名，九种目标语言各有对应译法；可展开查看完整列表。关闭其中一个不会影响另一个，也不会删除已填词条。

在“自定义补充”中添加自己的词条即可，无需复制内置内容。已启用的自定义同名词条（不区分大小写）优先覆盖内置译法；每种语言额外 128 条自定义额度不被内置词条占用。输入改动后会显示“未保存”提示并突出保存按钮；切换目标语言保留各语言草稿，并提醒其他语言的未保存项。正在编辑时刷新或离开网页会触发浏览器的未保存确认。

宽屏页面的术语表横跨整行，内置预览与自定义编辑左右排列，运行状态横向展示；窄窗口和设置弹窗使用单列。

在设置或侧边栏翻译页面编辑当前目标语言的术语表，每行填写“原词 => 译词”，点击“保存术语表”生效。两边写相同内容，可以固定保留产品名。

```text
DeepSeek => DeepSeek
agent => 智能体
reasoning => 思考过程
```

安装或升级后，看不到翻译入口 完整重启 `dsh web`。客户端模块图在进程启动时组合，仅刷新页面有时不足以加载新插件。设置页底部会显示实际安装包的版本号。
本地模型列表为空 检查 `ollama list` 或 `/api/tags`，确认运行中的服务使用了正确的模型目录；同时检查该服务生效的 `OLLAMA_MODELS`。不需要重新下载已经存在于其他模型目录中的文件。
升级 DSH 后，源码启动报 client bundles not found 在 DeepSeek Harness 仓库根目录先运行 `pnpm run build`，完成后重新启动 DSH Web。
翻译失败会影响正常对话吗

- 代码保护覆盖 Markdown 代码、明确可识别的路径、URL、文件名和常见命令片段；有空格的路径请加引号，复杂命令和有歧义的技术内容请使用反引号或代码块。
